description:
£155 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this spacious nine-bedroom student property, ideally located in a popular student area close to the city centre.

The property benefits from modern décor throughout and is well maintained, offering nine double bedrooms, three bathrooms and a spacious communal living area. Double glazing throughout adds to the comfort of the property.

Situated in a convenient location, the property is within easy reach of a variety of local takeaways, cafés and city centre amenities, making it an ideal choice for students.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our lettings team.
